title: Foods to Limit or Cook Thoroughly During Pregnancy
excerpt: Food-safety guidance inspired by CDC/NHS/FDA themes: deli meats, unpasteurized dairy, high-mercury fish, and undercooked foods.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, it's essential to choose safe and healthy foods. Pregnant women should limit or cook thoroughly certain foods to avoid the risk of bacterial contamination and protect their health and their baby's health.

## Foods to Limit
According to health organizations such as the CDC, NHS, and FDA, pregnant women should limit or avoid the following foods:
* Deli meats and ready-to-eat foods: Deli meats, hot dogs, and ready-to-eat foods can contain Listeria bacteria, which can cause listeriosis.
* Unpasteurized dairy products: Unpasteurized dairy products can contain E. coli, Salmonella, and Listeria bacteria.
* High-mercury fish: High-mercury fish like shark, swordfish, and king mackerel can cause mercury poisoning.
* Raw or undercooked foods: Raw or undercooked foods like sushi, sashimi, and raw eggs can contain Salmonella and E. coli bacteria.

## Foods to Cook Thoroughly
Pregnant women should also cook certain foods thoroughly to avoid the risk of bacterial contamination:
* Meat and poultry: Meat and poultry should be cooked to an internal temperature of at least 165°F (74°C) to avoid the risk of Salmonella and E. coli contamination.
* Eggs: Eggs should be cooked to an internal temperature of at least 165°F (74°C) to avoid the risk of Salmonella contamination.
* Seafood: Seafood should be cooked to an internal temperature of at least 145°F (63°C) to avoid the risk of Vibrio vulnificus contamination.

## Practical Tips
To ensure food safety, pregnant women can follow these tips:
* Always check the label before buying a product.
* Cook food thoroughly before eating.
* Avoid eating expired or spoiled food.
* Wash hands frequently before and after handling food.

## When to Seek Help
If pregnant women experience any of the following symptoms, they should seek medical help:
* High fever
* Abdominal pain
* Diarrhea
* Vomiting

faqs.question: Why should pregnant women limit deli meats?
faqs.answer: Deli meats can contain Listeria bacteria, which can cause listeriosis.

faqs.question: How should pregnant women cook food thoroughly?
faqs.answer: Cook food to an internal temperature of at least 165°F (74°C) to avoid the risk of bacterial contamination.

faqs.question: Can pregnant women eat sushi?
faqs.answer: No, sushi can contain Salmonella and E. coli bacteria, which can cause food poisoning.
